label: mANTBox 15s
description: 5 GHz point-to-point/multipoint sector radio, 15 dBi, 867 Mbps; 1x GigE + 1x GigE SFP, RouterOS.
notes: Power method from the mikrotik.com spec table: **PoE in: Passive PoE** (12-28 V) on `eth1`. Input is recorded on the first Ethernet port because the table states the method and voltage but does not name the port, and every MikroTik with a PoE-IN DC input takes it there. Max power consumption 13 W.
